title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: When you one-hot encode a sequence, each unique element in the sequence is represented as a separate dimension. Think about how many unique elements are in a DNA sequence and how this affects the dimensionality.

title: Exploring Codons
text: A codon is a sequence of $$3$$ DNA letters. Consider how many possible combinations of these $$3$$ letters exist. This will help you determine the number of dimensions when one-hot encoding codons.

title: Calculating Codon Combinations
text: How many different codons can be formed from the DNA letters T, G, C, and A?

title: Understanding 6-Letter Combinations
text: When considering 6-letter combinations, think about how many unique sequences of $$6$$ letters can be formed from the DNA alphabet. This will guide you in determining the dimensionality for one-hot encoding these combinations.

title: Calculating 6-Letter Combinations
text: How many different 6-letter combinations can be formed from the DNA letters T, G, C, and A?
